headword: {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}
gloss: passbook update; printing transactions in a bankbook

definitions.gloss: passbook update; printing transactions in a bankbook
definitions.explanation: Having recent deposits, withdrawals, and the running balance printed into a bank passbook. Typically done at an ATM, which has a dedicated slot for feeding in the passbook.

examples.japanese: ATMで{通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}をする。
examples.english: To update the passbook at an ATM.

examples.japanese: {久|ひさ}しぶりに{通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}したら{記録|きろく}がたくさん{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: When I updated my passbook after a long time, a lot of entries came out at once.

examples.japanese: {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}は{窓口|まどぐち}ではなく{専用|せんよう}のATMで{無料|むりょう}でできます。
examples.english: Passbook updates can be done free of charge at dedicated ATMs, not at the counter.

notes:
Compound of {通帳|つうちょう} (passbook) and {記入|きにゅう} (filling in, entering). The label appears on Japanese ATM menus and is a routine banking task. When too many transactions have accumulated while the passbook was not updated, the ATM may print a summary line instead of every transaction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}をする: to update the passbook
- {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}を{済|す}ませる: to finish updating the passbook
- {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}{機|き}: dedicated passbook-update machine
- {未記帳|みきちょう}{分|ぶん}の{通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}: updating with not-yet-printed transactions

RELATED TERMS:
- {通帳|つうちょう}: passbook — the booklet being updated
- {記帳|きちょう}: bookkeeping; making an entry in a book — a near-synonym that also appears on ATM menus as {記帳|きちょう}
- {預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}: bank passbook — the more formal full form
